svg.text: वैदिक: -आ (-ā) and -एन (-ena); e.g. यज्ञा / यज्ञेन (yajñā / yajñena).

text.font-family: Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit, Noto Serif Devanagari, serif

svg.text: Vedic verse can lengthen final -एन (-ena) to -एना (-enā) in

text.font-family: Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit, Noto Serif Devanagari, serif

svg.text: recitation, but that is a metrical realization of the -एन (-ena) form

text.font-family: Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit, Noto Serif Devanagari, serif

svg.text: rather than a third declensional ending.
